status_reason: Forge V2 Institutional Pipeline (VALIDATED): Trades=7, WinRate=42.9%, BaseNet=0.552%, StressNet=0.486%, WF=3/4, EarlyCuts=0, NearTPSaves=0, TPExpansions=0, MC95 DD=1.6%.

atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for EURUSD (SWING_TRADING). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=4.037, trend_persistence=0.28, mean_reversion=0.72. Learned timeframe weights: W1 (w=+0.252), D1 (w=+0.252), H4 (w=+0.252). Ablation-retained features: rsi_momentum (w=+0.386), ema_trend (w=+0.254), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.226), bos_breakout (w=+0.134) (pruned/left out by ablation: liquidity_sweep, fvg_impulse, sentinel_news_sentiment, pulse_social_sentiment).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for EURUSD (SWING_TRADING): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=4.037, mean-reversion=0.72). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to W1 (w=+0.252), D1 (w=+0.252), H4 (w=+0.252). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [rsi_momentum (w=+0.386), ema_trend (w=+0.254), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.226), bos_breakout (w=+0.134)] and pruned [liquidity_sweep, fvg_impulse, sentinel_news_sentiment, pulse_social_sentiment].

mtf_intelligence_and_sensitivity_report.design_rule_enforced: Contextual weighted agreement: trades are evaluated via learned timeframe weights and never rejected solely because all 7 timeframes do not point in the same direction.

data_synchronization_audit.candle_close_semantics: Higher-timeframe values become available only after bar_open + timeframe_duration <= trigger_close.

W1.initial_research_role: Broad market direction, major structure and long-term price zones.

D1.initial_research_role: Daily structure, support/resistance, supply/demand and regime context.

H4.initial_research_role: Intermediate trend, structural changes and developing opportunities.

H1.initial_research_role: Refined directional bias and developing trade setups.

A_Baseline_Frozen_V1_Incumbent.research_question: What does the current frozen V1 strategy do under verified test and cost assumptions?

B_Structure_Based.research_question: Does a market-structure stop and dynamic target improve outcomes?

C_ATR_Based.research_question: Does volatility-adjusted stop/target logic improve robustness?

D_Hybrid_Real_Trader_Dynamic_Reanalysis.research_question: Does combining structure, volatility, and live 3-layer dynamic re-analysis improve results?

E_Sizing_Variant.research_question: Does an alternative sizing method improve risk-adjusted outcomes without increasing permitted risk?

execution_model.spread_accounting_policy: OHLC basis is 'bid'; full spread (0.18 bps base / 0.36 bps stress) applied exactly once per round-turn without double-counting.

transitions.reason: Hypothesis, baseline incumbent snapshot, and immutable experiment contract recorded.
Controlled 60% development training, timeframe/component ablation, and policy search executed.
Chronological walk-forward and untouched 40% lockbox evaluation outputs produced under base and stress costs.
Passed independent holdout validation (Net=+1.104R, StressNet=+0.972R, WF Folds=3/4, MC95 DD=1.6%).

twelve_step_validation_ledger.activity: Define hypothesis and expected measurable effect
Select incumbent, baseline and experiment context
Create an immutable experiment contract
Select data, features, configuration and cost profile
Execute controlled training or candidate generation
Evaluate development performance
Run chronological walk-forward testing
Run independent out-of-sample validation
Apply statistical, stress and robustness tests
Benchmark candidate against incumbent
Produce an evidence report with limitations
Apply certification and deployment governance
